headline: Polymarket Odds for US-Iran Meeting Fall to 24% After Tehran Rejection
summary: Polymarket traders dropped odds of a senior US-Iran meeting by 13 points to 24% after Tehran stated it saw no need to meet.
why: Prediction markets aggregate geopolitical sentiment and expectations regarding international diplomatic breakthroughs or escalations.

impacts.name: Iran
impacts.why: Odds of diplomatic talks between the US and Iran decreased.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Direct statements from Iranian officials declining the need for a meeting caused prediction market traders to reprice the probability of diplomatic engagement downward.
